name: Barnaby Bruin
bio: Top hat, red coat, impeccable manners. Apologises before every headshot, and means it.
notes: From the owner's T-pose uploads (2026-11-01, "found some new ones"): an unrigged textured GLB, rigged here from T-pose landmarks (arms level; the manifest's landmarks, read off front and side views). Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. Not Teddy (a plush toy): a bear in a striped red coat, waistcoat, ruff and top hat. His fur (1.5M triangles, many texture islands) held the careful cut at 23k triangles, over the 20k budget: `looseCut` cuts the body looser (then sloppily) to 12.9k, the head and hands keeping their careful cut. Paws measure as closed blocks: `hands.curl` 1 makes them mittens that close on the grip.
